# Plebly

> Plebly is a public funding platform for Bitcoin development and research. Donors send sats to publicly verifiable on-chain escrow. No custodian can freeze or redirect escrow.

Listings and escrow balances are on the site at https://plebly.fund. Published fees and keyholder rules are in git. Lightning donations (when enabled) settle into the same on-chain escrow after an on-chain sweep.

## Site

- [Home / open projects](https://plebly.fund/): Browse listed projects and escrow funding progress
- [About](https://plebly.fund/about): Beliefs, how it works, fees, and network status
- [Start a project](https://plebly.fund/propose): List a bounty or campaign (login; on-chain fee required)
- [Funding stats](https://plebly.fund/stats): Public funding and completion totals
- [Reviewers](https://plebly.bitcoin/reviewers): Reviewer roster and open decisions
- [Reviewer rules](https://plebly.bitcoin/reviewer-responsibilities): Who can review and how a vote passes
- [Keyholder responsibilities](https://plebly.bitcoin/keyholder-responsibilities): What a keyholder does and how they are paid
- [Full context for LLMs](https://plebly.bitcoin/llms-full.txt): Longer plain-text overview of product rules and flows

## Projects

- [Signet smoke test bounty](https://plebly.fund/p/plebly-signet-demo): listed — Need a live signet proposal to exercise listing, balance display, and the claim floor path without mainnet risk
- [Knots PR: reject high size-to-value relay spam](https://plebly.fund/p/plebly-knots-size-value-spam): listed — Bitcoin Knots already has strong relay knobs for datacarrier weight, tokens (-rejecttokens), parasites (-reject

## Protocol (published rules)

- [PARAMETERS.md](https://github.com/Plebly/proposals/blob/main/PARAMETERS.md): Fees, claim floor, windows
- [Keyholders](https://plebly.fund/about#keyholders): Multisig roster and rules
- [TESTING.md](https://github.com/Plebly/proposals/blob/main/TESTING.md): Signet / end-to-end testing notes
